La Teja informa: Albanese llegó al país para recibir un doctorado honoris causa, por parte del Consejo Universitario de la UCR. Semanario Universidad informa: "Pedimos a las autoridades que reconsideren esta decisión con carácter urgente y le permitan entrar en el país", indicó Volker Türk en un mensaje en X. De acuerdo con El Financiero (Costa Rica), el Alto Comisionado de la ONU para los Derechos Humanos dijo el viernes estar “muy preocupado” por la decisión de Costa Rica de impedir la entrada en el país de Francesca Albanese.
stories.narrEn: RFI reports: Costa Rica's government said Thursday it had denied entry to UN rapporteur Francesca Albanese, who has accused Israel of genocide, because she was the subject of an "international alert over links to terrorist acts". Q Costa Rica reports: Q COSTA RICA — Costa Rican immigration authorities refused entry to Francesca Albanese on Thursday after the Italian legal scholar, expert on human rights and United Nations expert, arrived from France to receive an honorary doctorate from the Universidad de Costa Rica (UCR)—University of Costa Rica. stories.narrEn: According to RFI, the military government in Guinea-Bissau on Thursday postponed the country's presidential and legislative elections until November 2028, extending its promised year-long transition to civilian rule by two years.
